items.title: CBRE Q2 Deep Dive: Data Center and Infrastructure Growth Drive Upgraded Outlook
items.summary: Commercial real estate firm CBRE (NYSE:CBRE) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 15.2% year on year to $11.19 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.56 per share was 5.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: CBRE (CBRE) Advises On Senior Living Deal As Industrial Leases Get Bigger
